description: We are Team Innovative Minds from  India - a group of students passionate about space education and storytelling. We love building simple, kid-friendly tech with HTML, CSS, JS and NASA open data. Our project ECHOES turns 800+ abandoned Moon & Mars hardware into cute Pixar-like characters teaching science to kids 7-14 yrs. We are looking for teammates who like design, storytelling, and making space fun for schools. Join us!
